verdict.rationale: First-party docs say ByteAsk can drive any OpenAI-compatible model in its TUI "exactly like a built-in cloud model." It also offers one-word presets for bring-your-own-key providers (OpenRouter, Groq, Together, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, Cerebras, Fireworks), and its default 'auto' mode chains three models across two providers. missing for 10: the exact selection mechanism (a model flag or slash command) is not shown in the evidence, there is no list of built-in models to choose from, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers

citations.quote: Bring **any OpenAI-compatible model** into the ByteAsk TUI and drive it exactly like a built-in cloud model.
A cloud provider with your own key - OpenRouter, Groq, Together, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, Cerebras, or Fireworks, via a one-word preset.
auto is now a chain across three models and two providers rather than a single fixed choice
